title: Starter: Scene Loop
summary: A minimal looping scene to copy: a cabin and a pine on a hill from a warm dusk into a rainy night, with a lofi soundtrack and sprites as hand-drawn pixel maps. Its dusk frame (the first picture) and its rain frame pass the lofi frame gate.
request: Unknown: the original request was not recorded in the repository. Template from the first kit commits; no request exists. Source description: Hilltop Cabin: a starter scene for pixelate-anything.
